claim: Map/model assessment should use multiple metrics because RMSE, MAE, ME, R2_pred, RPD/RPIQ and NSE emphasize different aspects of predictive performance.
conditions: Applies to predictive performance reporting, especially where bias and outliers matter.
limitations: Metric thresholds are context-dependent and should not be treated as universal agronomic quality grades.
recommended_action: Report at least RMSE, MAE, ME and R2_pred; add RPD/RPIQ/NSE when meaningful.
not_allowed_action: Do not hide poor bias or negative R2_pred behind a single favorable metric.
